units.source_text: 话说源氏公子经常悄悄地到六条[\[2\]](#part1333.html#m2)去访问。

en.t: Now Prince Genji often went secretly to Rokujo[\[2\]](#part1333.html#m2) to pay visits.

units.source_text: 有一次他从宫中赴六条，到了中途休息的地方，想起住在五条的大弍乳母[\[3\]](#part1333.html#m3)曾生了一场大病，为了祈愿复健，削发为尼，源氏公子便前去探望。

en.t: Once, while he was on his way from the palace to Rokujo and had reached a resting place along the road, he remembered that his nurse, the Daini nurse[\[3\]](#part1333.html#m3) who lived in Gojo, had once been seriously ill and had cut her hair to become a nun in prayer for recovery, so Prince Genji went to visit her.

units.source_text: 到了那里，看见可以通车的大门关着，便派人叫乳母的儿子惟光大夫出来，打开大门。

en.t: When he arrived there and saw that the large gate wide enough for a carriage was closed, he sent someone to call out the nurse's son, Koremitsu no Taifu, and had him open the gate.

units.source_text: 源氏公子坐在车子里望望这条肮脏的大街上的光景，忽见乳母家隔壁有一家人家，新装着丝柏薄板条编成的板垣，板垣上面高高地开着吊窗，共有四五架[\[4\]](#part1333.html#m4)。

en.t: As Prince Genji sat in his carriage and looked out at the scene along this dirty main street, he suddenly noticed a house next door to his nurse's home, with a newly made fence woven from thin strips of cypress board and four or five high-hung shuttered windows[\[4\]](#part1333.html#m4) set above it.

units.source_text: 窗内挂的帘子也很洁白，看了觉得很凉爽。

en.t: The curtains hanging inside the windows were also very white, giving a cool and refreshing impression.

units.source_text: 从帘影间可以看见室内有许多留着美丽的额发的女人，正在向这边窥探。

en.t: Through the shadows of the curtains, he could see many women inside with beautifully arranged forehead hair, peering out toward him.

units.source_text: 这些女人移动不定，想来个子都很高。

en.t: These women shifted about restlessly, and they all seemed to be quite tall.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得奇怪，不知道里面住的是何等样人。

en.t: Prince Genji found it strange and wondered what sort of people lived inside.
